_what: HestiaCP servers. Mirrors servers.json (the Plesk registry) so the Servers tab can read both the same way. TRIAL CONFIG - delete this file and lib/hestia*.php if Hestia loses the comparison.

servers.label: Hestia trial box
servers._auth: Prefer an access key pair: Hestia -> Server Settings -> Configure -> Security -> Access Keys. The admin user/password fields are a fallback for older boxes and are only read if the pair is blank.
servers._site_user: ONE Hestia account owns every site on this server. A Hestia user is a Linux account; one per site would mean 500 of them per box, 500 slow v-add-user calls, and a 501-call listing (domains hang off accounts, so the account count IS the call count). FTP logins are still issued per domain, so nothing is shared that a site can see. Consequence: never call v-delete-user on this account - it would take every site on the server with it.
servers._ip: IP the vhosts bind to and Cloudflare points at. Usually the same as host.
servers._package: Hestia package applied to the account. 'default' carries mail and database quotas you do not need; make a static-only package with mail and DNS disabled.

_enable: The API is OFF by default. On the box: v-add-sys-api, then allow the factory IP (187.127.254.206) in API_ALLOWED_IP. A disallowed caller gets HTTP 200 with the body 'Error' - not an auth failure you can see from the status code. Firewall 8083 to that IP only.
